# Parvez Siddiqui — Freelance Video Editor & AI Content Creator

> Personal portfolio of Parvez Siddiqui, a freelance video editor and AI content creator who helps brands, creators and startups turn raw footage and ideas into high-performing content.

## What he does
- Short-form video editing (Reels, Shorts, TikToks, social-first content)
- Long-form video editing (YouTube, educational content, podcasts, storytelling)
- Motion graphics (kinetic typography, animations, transitions, visual effects)
- AI video production (AI-generated visuals, AI-assisted workflows)
- Social media content for Instagram, YouTube and other platforms
- Content repurposing (one long-form video into multiple short-form assets)

## Background
- 2.5+ years of freelance video editing experience
- Runs Tech Hacks AI, a tech/AI content platform: 150K+ Instagram followers (@tech_hacks.ai), 11.8K+ Telegram subscribers, 4.9K+ YouTube subscribers
